text: TaskFlow has been solid for our team but I keep wishing for a Slack integration so updates don't get lost in yet another inbox.
Great tool overall, 5 stars. The reporting could be more flexible though, we can't export the exact breakdown our clients ask for.
Mobile app experience on Android is rough, laggy and occasionally crashes when uploading attachments. iOS version is much better.
Switched from a competitor mainly for the clean UI. Only complaint is there's no dark mode yet, which strains my eyes at night.
Billing has been a headache, got double charged once and the invoice history page doesn't clearly show plan changes.
Would be amazing to have a Zapier connector, we automate everything else in our stack and TaskFlow is the missing piece.
Onboarding new hires takes way too long because there's no interactive tutorial, just a static help page.
Love the product overall. Push notifications on mobile would make it perfect, currently I miss assignments unless I open the app.
Security-wise I'd like to see 2FA support, we handle sensitive client data and our compliance team keeps asking about it.
Excellent task management core features. A Google Calendar sync would remove a lot of manual double-entry for our team.
Reports are too rigid, we can only see last 7 or 30 days. Quarterly and custom range reporting would help a lot for our reviews.
Android app performance really needs work, it's noticeably slower than the iOS app and the web version.
